name: shiftly
description: Role-based team scheduling platform with drag-and-drop shift planning, conflict detection, a shift-swap approval workflow, and real-time notifications.

scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w backend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w frontend
